scope: read-only source audit plus minimal CPU synthetic projection / adapter probes; no browser, GPU, OS capture, resource measurement or UI
timing: Author planned API and source SHA received; candidate source, author cases and results unread at freeze. Original prototype model/scene source read earlier. Root owns actual UI.
authority: R2 adapter / R3 readBody is sole material text/id/ink authority. Ephemeral rendering views and view birth time are permitted but are not canonical commit proofs.

numericThresholds.tile: exact token preservation if API exposes it
numericThresholds.finite: all exposed derived scalar fields finite; CPU geometry numeric formula evidence is separate from GPU visual equivalence

interpretation: Readonly view arrays may contain glyph text but may not allocate material identity or invoke Matter.add. Placeholder @ may exist as DOM decoration only; body0 must project0. Camera/basis/source reuse claims must be scoped to actual source and numeric probes; authored ring→mobius mapping is not learned semantics.
publication: Only artificial fixture text in owned probe files; results report IDs/counts/ink/aggregate, no user text. Commands relative repository paths. No edit shared candidate/source/raw/Git.
